An '''accu-accelerator''' was a component<ref name="EGWT" /> from the ignition system<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> in a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship's]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]]. The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] scavenged accu-accelerators from the wrecks of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and used them as an integral part of their custom-built [[Jawa ionization blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blasters]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Combined with a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]], the accu-accelerator was part of a specially built [[Ion accelerator/Legends|ion accelerator]].<ref name="CRFG" /> When an ionization blaster was fired, it activated the restraining bolt, broadcasting the droid shut-down command which was amplified by the accu-accelerator.<ref name="EGWT" />
